name: llmservingsim
description: LLMServingSim — LLM serving traffic trace generator (KAIST)
local_modifications: serving/ = upstream a4053bc base + forward-ported VeritX BookSim backend (upstream deleted theirs): booksim CLI choice, --booksim-replay-only, _prepare_booksim_config (anynet/mesh), spawn args (remote-memory, flit-bytes, physical-dims via logical_dims.json), controller BookSim parsing, dispatched-only retirement via dp_pending inspection, multi-instance round-robin fallback
serving: loud early-backend-death guard (exit 1 + stderr tail), zero-division guard on empty results, background stderr-drain thread (backend logs ~510B/round; undrained pipe stalls ~round 1500)
serving/validate-baselines-booksim.txt: our BookSim-backend clocks for 4 serve scenarios (upstream validate.sh needs their analytical N-dim backend)
inputs/, extern/ kept locally (experiment inputs, not upstream)
configs/cluster dual_node_kv_remote, moe_tight_mem, rtxpro_single + configs/model Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 kept locally (not in upstream HEAD)
astra-sim/ kept as absolute symlinks into third_party/astra-sim (see third_party/README P1); upstream .gitmodules dropped
upstream .github/ dropped (their CI, not applicable to vendored copy)
known_gaps: No standalone binary — runs as python -m serving
Profiler requires GPU (RTXPRO6000) for hardware latency measurement
Block-pool scheduler (upstream 2cf3f12) not adopted — ours still uses radix-tree allocator; adopt on KV-pressure bugs only
Our analytical binary is 1-dim-only; multi-dim needs booksim backend
Host venv must pip-install chakra from third_party/astra-sim/extern/graph_frontend/chakra (needs protobuf>=7.35.1); image has no chakra package
build_command: echo 'No build needed — Python package. Install deps: pip install -r requirements.txt'
